title: Martha
html_source:
Bloom’s fancy woman penpal (she responded to an ad for a typist) which allow safe sexual thoughts and reference while Boylan blazes away in the afternoon (sorry !). The equivalent of texting a colleague in work these days.

In his chapter 1918-1919, Ellmann describes Joyce’s mild stalking of a Swiss woman with whom he struck up a hidden relationship. She reminded him of an epiphany Joyce had watching a girl paddle on Sandymount Strand many years previous which Stephen also had on Dollymount strand in Portrait.
